scenarios.title: SPDM responder
scenarios.description: The host is an SPDM requester. It sends GET_VERSION, GET_CAPABILITIES and NEGOTIATE_ALGORITHMS to the responder as MCTP messages over I3C. It then reads the certificate chain of slot 0 with GET_DIGESTS and GET_CERTIFICATE and checks the chain's hashes. Last, it checks that the responder refuses GET_CERTIFICATE for an empty slot and CHALLENGE, and answers the request after that.

scenarios.title: Flash driver
scenarios.description: The firmware erases, programs and reads back the primary flash through the flash HAL.

scenarios.title: Flash service
scenarios.description: A client app erases, programs and reads back flash through the flash service, and checks that the server rejects requests outside the flash or not aligned to an erase block.

scenarios.title: SHA driver
scenarios.description: The firmware checks SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests of known messages, computed by the Caliptra core over its mailbox.

scenarios.title: RNG driver
scenarios.description: The firmware asks the Caliptra core for random bytes over its mailbox and checks that the driver fills buffers of several lengths.

scenarios.title: ECDSA driver
scenarios.description: The firmware asks the Caliptra core to verify a known P-384 signature, and checks that verification fails for a changed digest, key or signature.

scenarios.title: DPE driver
scenarios.description: The firmware certifies a key with the DPE of the Caliptra core, signs a digest with it, checks the signature and reads the certificate chain.

scenarios.title: MCI driver
scenarios.description: The firmware reads and writes the MCI registers and takes the MCI interrupt for events that it triggers.

scenarios.title: ROM handoff table
scenarios.description: A service reads the handoff table that the MCU ROM leaves for the firmware and checks what the ROM recorded for this boot.
